column1: # PURPOSE (DDC-02): the machine-readable registry naming, for each topic, the ONE current owner doc
#   + its currency + a content hash. The single input the fail-closed checker enforces; the
# STATE CONTRACT: exactly one A1 owner row per topic_id. On owner change, supersede the row IN PLACE
#   (do not append a second current row). This file is STATE — it holds current truth, not history.
#   - at most one A1 owner row per topic_id            (fail on duplicate topic owner)
#   - every registered path/id resolves to a real file (fail on missing / dangling / symlink)
#   - every non-self row hash matches current bytes    (fail on drift)
#   - no unregistered CURRENT doc exists in the active set (fail on orphan current doc)
#   - known_conflict_ids resolve in the DDC-11 ledger
#   - self-row hash lives in an external sidecar (no self-referential hash cycle)
# One row per topic. hash = sha256 of the target's current bytes (blank for the self row -> sidecar).
# SELF ROW (hash bound by sidecar head-manifest.sha256, NOT inline):
